message.content: { "ranking": [ { "id": "patch_b42f68f8b120", "mechanism": "phy_tx_data in WRITE_BIT path now driven by scl_o, linking physical bit emission to SCL output state rather than a constant." }, { "id": "patch_a614de3b9c24", "mechanism": "phy_write_bit now driven by s_axis_cmd_ready, coupling physical write emission to command interface readiness." }, { "id": "patch_40a550fb3580", "mechanism": "phy_read_bit gated by m_axis_data_tready, so a read operation only proceeds when the output channel can accept data." }, { "id": "patch_353450f10494", "mechanism": "phy_read_bit driven by m_axis_data_tvalid_reg, making physical read dependent on valid output register state." }, { "id": "patch_64d2bd7aca6b", "mechanism": "phy_tx_data sourced from missed_ack_next in PHY_STATE_WRITE_BIT_2 path, feeding back ACK status into transmit data." }, { "id": "patch_a20388282eab", "mechanism": "phy_tx_data sourced from s_axis_data_tready_reg, linking transmit data to data-channel readiness register." }, { "id": "patch_1eaa912ddb03", "mechanism": "missed_ack_reg updated from scl_negedge, capturing ACK detection on SCL falling edge." }, { "id": "patch_dd3edbcc7820", "mechanism": "sda_o_next replaced with missed_ack_next, driving SDA output with missed-ACK status." } ], "explanation": "Ranking prioritizes candidates that directly manipulate core I2C physical-layer signals (phy_tx_data, phy_write_bit, phy_read_bit, scl_o, sda_o, missed_ack_reg) and bus activity indicators (bus_active). Substitutions tied to SCL/SDA timing (patch_b42f68f8b120, patch_1eaa912ddb03) and command/read-data handshakes (patch_a614de3b9c24, patch_40a550fb3580, patch_353450f10494) are ranked highest because bus_active failures at cycles 8-17 suggest the bus-active handshake (repeated start, SCL toggling, SDA release) is not completing. Lower-ranked candidates substitute outputs with loosely related status signals (busy, missed_ack_next) that are less likely to restore the precise SCL/SDA sequencing required for bus_active assertion." }
